title: Valencia DANA
question: After the 2024 DANA floods, is it raining more and more in Valencia, or is something else changing?
context: On 29 October 2024 a DANA storm dropped months of rain on Valencia in a few hours and killed more than 220 people.

facts.PRECTOTCORR:
Place: Valencia (39.470, -0.380)
Variable: PRECTOTCORR (mm/day). Data: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 based) PRECTOTCORR
Period: 1981-01 to 2024-12, 528 valid months
Trend: 0.00475 mm/day/year (0.0475 mm/day/decade), 95% CI -0.000588 to 0.0103 mm/day/year
Total change over the period: 0.209 mm/day
Mann-Kendall p-value: p = 0.0919, not significant at the 5% level
Direction: no statistically significant trend
A non-significant result means the data show no clear evidence of change, not proof that nothing changed.
facts.T2M:
Place: Valencia (39.470, -0.380)
Variable: T2M (°C). Data: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 based) T2M
Period: 1981-01 to 2024-12, 528 valid months
Trend: 0.0272 °C/year (0.272 °C/decade), 95% CI 0.017 to 0.0376 °C/year
Total change over the period: 1.19 °C
Mann-Kendall p-value: p < 0.001, significant at the 5% level
Direction: increasing
